note: No machine-learning group in the atlas; group left OTHER. Edge to the atlas node convolution is real: a 2-D kernel is the same flip-free sliding weighted sum.

description.zh: 3×3 卷积核在图像上滑动，对应相乘求和得到特征图；不同的核响应不同的边缘，ReLU、池化与堆叠把边缘拼成更复杂的特征，核也可以由梯度下降学出。合成小图、单通道的教学模型。
description.en: A 3×3 kernel slides over an image, multiplying and summing to give a feature map; different kernels respond to different edges, ReLU, pooling and stacking assemble edges into richer features, and kernels can be learned by gradient descent. A teaching model with small synthetic images and one channel.

label.zh: 一维滑动求和 → 二维图像

reason.zh: 图像卷积层做的仍是“滑动窗口、对应相乘、求和”，只是窗口变成二维，且按 CNN 惯例不翻转核。
reason.en: An image convolution layer still does “slide a window, multiply matching entries, sum”, only in two dimensions and, by CNN convention, without flipping the kernel.

label.zh: 边缘核是差分，近似导数
label.en: Edge kernels are differences, approximating derivatives

reason.zh: 左负右正的边缘核计算左右像素之差，是对图像亮度求导数的离散近似，所以平坦处输出 0。
reason.en: A left-negative, right-positive edge kernel computes the difference between neighbouring pixels, a discrete approximation of the brightness derivative, so flat regions give 0.

title.zh: 卷积神经网络是怎么“看”图的？
title.en: How does a convolutional network “see” a picture?
